open.title: Build the first stadium
open.body: Home games sold out all season, which earned a stadium of your own: 8,000 seats against 3,000 today. Work takes 24 hours and only starts out of season. A bigger stadium is louder for the dorms around it.

options.label: Build it for $1,685,486
options.detail: Opens 24 hours after you say yes. The team plays where it does now until then.

options.label: Not this year
options.detail: It stays earned. You are asked again next spring.

open.title: Keep the Library open late
open.body: At the height of finals, Stress here would reach about 53 of 100. Students ask for the Library to stay open late until exams are over. The librarians ask for the same thing in fewer words.

options.label: Pay for late hours: $280,914
options.detail: Stress is 10 points lower for three days.
